unset.defaultPolicy: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
unset.cap: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.

defaultPolicy.notCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
defaultPolicy.humanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.

cap.notCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
cap.humanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.
